single.dir: Questions 147–150 refer to the following e-mail.
single.passage_html:
From Mina Park, Human Resources
To All Department Managers
Date October 24
Subject Stakeholder briefing — Plant B restructuring

Dear Managers,

As announced last week, Plant B will complete its restructuring by November 30. Before we finalize the employee list, please join a stakeholder meeting on Monday at 10:00 a.m. in Conference Room A. Key stakeholders from Operations, Finance, and Legal will review the project timeline and confirm which roles are affected.

Employees whose positions are eliminated will receive a severance package equal to four months of base pay, plus continued health coverage through year-end. Managers must not discuss individual cases until HR has issued a formal termination notice. If you have questions about accounts payable related to the package, contact Finance before Friday.

Please reply by 5:00 p.m. today to confirm your attendance. We will reconvene the same group next Thursday if a quorum is not reached on Monday.

Regards,
Mina Park
HR Business Partner

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?

choices.A: To announce the opening of a new plant
choices.B: To invite managers to a meeting about restructuring
choices.C: To request approval for a government subsidy
choices.D: To introduce a new company spokesperson

questions.zh_stem: 这封邮件的主要目的是什么？

zh_opts.B: 邀请经理参加有关重组的会议

questions.rationale: 邮件核心是请经理参加周一 stakeholder meeting 讨论重组。

questions.stem: According to the e-mail, what will affected employees receive?

choices.A: A promotion and a training stipend
choices.B: Four months of base pay and health coverage through year-end
choices.C: A monthly retainer and stock options
choices.D: Only a written apology from Legal

questions.zh_stem: 根据邮件，受影响员工将获得什么？

zh_opts.B: 四个月基本工资，以及持续至年底的医保
zh_opts.C: 月度顾问费与股票期权

questions.rationale: four months of base pay, plus continued health coverage through year-end。

questions.stem: When should managers reply to confirm attendance?
questions.zh_stem: 经理应在何时回复确认出席？
questions.rationale: reply by 5:00 p.m. today。「周五前」是联系财务的时限。

questions.stem: What will happen if not enough people attend on Monday?

choices.C: The same group will meet again next Thursday
choices.D: Legal will publish the employee list online

questions.zh_stem: 若周一出席人数不够会发生什么？

zh_opts.B: 财务部将立即发放遣散费
zh_opts.C: 同一批人将于下周四再开会
zh_opts.D: 法务部将在网上公布员工名单

questions.rationale: reconvene … next Thursday if a quorum is not reached。

发件人：Mina Park，人力资源部 / 收件人：各部门经理 / 日期：10 月 24 日 / 主题：利益相关方简报——B 厂重组
各位经理：如上周所宣布，B 厂将于 11 月 30 日前完成重组。请于周一上午 10:00 到 A 会议室参加会议。运营、财务与法务关键干系人将审阅时间表并确认受影响岗位。岗位取消者将获四个月基本工资遣散方案及至年底医保。正式解雇通知发出前经理不得讨论个案。应付账款问题请周五前联系财务。请今日下午 5:00 前回复确认；若周一未达法定人数，下周四复会。

Advertisement

Harborview Business Suites — Short-Term Offices

Fully furnished offices available by the week or month. Packages include high-speed internet, meeting rooms, and weekday reception service from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

• Standard Suite: $650 / week
• Corner Suite: $890 / week
• Virtual Mailbox only: $45 / month

Book online at harborview-suites.example or call 555-0142. Mention code SPRING10 for 10% off stays of two weeks or longer.

E-mail
From Kenji Watanabe
To reservations@harborview-suites.example
Date April 2
Subject Corner Suite inquiry — April 14–25

Hello,

I need a Corner Suite from April 14 through April 25 for a visiting consultant. We will require meeting-room access on April 16 and 17. Please confirm availability and whether code SPRING10 can be applied. Invoice should go to Accounts Payable at Apex Logistics.

Thank you,
Kenji Watanabe
Apex Logistics
